title.zh: 梅特兰新英格兰公路西行立交进入勘测与地质调查阶段
title.en: Maitland's New England Highway westbound flyover moves into survey and geotechnical investigations

summary.zh: 联邦政府宣布全额出资1亿澳元推进梅特兰西行立交，Transport for NSW将开展道路、排水、地下管线和地质调查，为设计提供依据。工程重点是设计冻结前共同识别交通、地下条件和施工期影响。
summary.en: The Australian Government will fully fund the A$100 million Maitland westbound flyover. Transport for NSW will survey roads, drainage, utilities and geotechnical conditions to inform design. The engineering focus is coordinated definition of traffic, subsurface and construction impacts before design is fixed.

watch.zh: 关注勘测成果如何改变地基、排水、管线迁改和施工期交通方案。
watch.en: Watch how investigations change foundation, drainage, utility-relocation, and construction-traffic decisions.

liveUpdates.reference: Maitland New England Highway westbound upgrade

title.zh: Goulburn Valley货运园区完工，把联运连接与高生产率车辆纳入同一网络
title.en: Goulburn Valley freight precinct completes a network upgrade for intermodal links and high-productivity vehicles

summary.zh: Goulburn Valley Link Freight Precinct已完成，总投资2250万澳元用于道路和环岛，并连接墨尔本港联运设施。项目显示区域货运价值还取决于路口几何、重载车辆安全和全国运输网络接口。
summary.en: The Goulburn Valley Link Freight Precinct is complete after A$22.5 million of road and roundabout works, linking its intermodal terminal with the Port of Melbourne. Regional freight value also depends on intersection geometry, heavy-vehicle safety, and national-network interfaces.

watch.zh: 关注高生产率车辆转弯轨迹、路面耐久性和联运运行数据。
watch.en: Watch turning paths, pavement durability, and operating data at the intermodal node.

liveUpdates.reference: Goulburn Valley Link Freight Precinct completion

title.zh: Kwinana Freeway升级合同把拓宽与匝道信号协同推进
title.en: Kwinana Freeway upgrade contract combines widening with coordinated ramp signals

summary.zh: Kwinana Freeway超过29公里路段的升级合同已授予，项目包括拓宽、附加车道和11个匝道协调信号，目标是形成42公里连续智慧高速公路。详细设计需统筹路基、桥涵、排水、交通转换和智能交通设备维护接口。
summary.en: A contract has been awarded to upgrade more than 29 kilometres of Perth's Kwinana Freeway with widening, extra lanes and coordinated signals at 11 ramps, targeting 42 kilometres of continuous smart freeway. Detailed design must coordinate pavement, structures, drainage, traffic staging, and intelligent-transport maintenance.

watch.zh: 关注拓宽、信号、排水、桥涵和交通转换是否按系统性能共同设计。
watch.en: Watch whether widening, signals, drainage, structures, and traffic staging share system requirements.

title.zh: 数字化趋势正在从建模展示转向可审计的交付能力
title.en: Digital engineering is shifting from model presentation toward auditable delivery capability

summary.zh: 2026年建筑业调查把战略、组织、工具、数据基础设施和技能都视为数字能力。趋势不是单纯增加BIM软件，而是让设计变更、现场记录、资产数据和风险决策可追溯，并把数据质量与工程责任绑定。
summary.en: The 2026 construction study treats strategy, organisation, tools, data infrastructure, and skills as digital capability. The trend is traceability across design changes, site records, asset data, and risk decisions, with data quality tied to engineering accountability.

watch.zh: 关注数字交付是否定义数据责任人、格式、版本控制和验收证据。
watch.en: Watch whether digital delivery defines data owners, formats, version control, and acceptance evidence.

insights.reference: State of Digital Adoption in Construction 2026

title.zh: 低碳胶凝材料把耐久性从单一指标推向多机制耦合判断
title.en: Low-carbon binders are moving concrete durability toward coupled-mechanism judgement

summary.zh: 2026年研究指出，低熟料体系受孔隙溶液化学、pH缓冲和微观结构共同影响，并涉及氯离子、碳化、腐蚀和硫酸盐侵蚀。设计趋势是把配合比、暴露环境、早龄期性能、施工质量和维护放在同一证据链。
summary.en: A 2026 study reports that low-clinker durability depends on pore-solution chemistry, pH buffering and microstructure, alongside chloride ingress, carbonation, corrosion and sulfate attack. The trend is one evidence chain for mix, exposure, early-age behaviour, construction quality and maintenance.

watch.zh: 关注暴露类别、早龄期收缩、施工窗口和现场耐久性验证是否同步定义。
watch.en: Watch whether exposure, early-age shrinkage, construction windows, and field durability checks are defined together.

insights.reference: Durability of concrete prepared with low-carbon binders

title.zh: 道路设计开始同时面对自动驾驶、电动车与数字基础设施变化
title.en: Road design is beginning to address automated vehicles, EVs, and digital infrastructure together

summary.zh: Austroads 2026年报告提出，澳新道路机构需要为自动驾驶、联网车辆、电动车和协同智能交通系统准备物理与数字基础设施。路侧设备、通信、电力、标线和维护责任成为长期可适应性问题，应明确未来改造路径。
summary.en: An Austroads 2026 report says road agencies need physical and digital infrastructure ready for automated vehicles, connected vehicles, EVs and cooperative ITS. Roadside equipment, communications, power, markings and maintenance become long-term adaptability issues, requiring future retrofit paths.

watch.zh: 关注新建道路是否预留设备、电力、通信和维护升级的可达空间。
watch.en: Watch whether new roads reserve accessible space for equipment, power, communications, and maintenance upgrades.

title.zh: 火灾设计不是只看耐火时间：中外规范如何理解结构在火中的承载与变形？
title.en: Fire design is not only a fire rating: how practice treats structural capacity and deformation

intro.zh: 耐火设计需要把火灾工况、温度发展、材料强度与刚度退化、热膨胀约束、构件变形和整体稳定联系起来；耐火时间是性能判定的一部分，不是脱离荷载路径和构造细节的单一数字。
intro.en: Fire design connects the fire scenario, temperature development, material degradation, thermal restraint, member deformation and global stability. A fire period is part of the performance decision, not a standalone number detached from load paths and detailing.

title.zh: 中国：按火灾工况核查承载与变形
title.en: China: check capacity and deformation in the fire situation

text.zh: 耐火设计应联系防火分区、构件耐火极限、温度场和火灾下承载力；常温承载力结果不能直接作为火灾结论。
text.en: Fire design links compartmentation, member fire resistance, temperature fields and capacity in fire; room-temperature capacity is not the fire conclusion.

title.zh: 欧洲：把热作用、材料退化和约束效应放进分析
title.en: Europe: include thermal actions, degradation and restraint

text.zh: 欧洲规范将热作用、温度相关材料性能和结构分析作为耐火验证路径，可在构件或整体结构层级证明性能。
text.en: Eurocodes use thermal actions, temperature-dependent properties and structural analysis to demonstrate performance at member or system level.

title.zh: 共同要求：防火构造与结构分析互相支持
title.en: Shared requirement: detailing and analysis must support each other

text.zh: 涂层、包覆、连接、楼板连续性、变形容许度和防火分隔会改变温度与荷载路径；模型必须匹配实际构造。
text.en: Protection, connections, slab continuity, deformation tolerance and compartmentation change temperature and load paths; the model must match the built detail.

takeaway.zh: 耐火设计的核心是把火灾情景、热分析、退化材料、约束变形和防火构造放在同一证据链上。
takeaway.en: Fire design requires one evidence chain connecting the fire scenario, thermal analysis, degraded materials, restrained deformation and protection detailing.

title.zh: 参考实例：钢构件火灾工况概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual screen for a steel member in fire

intro.zh: 以下是派生概念筛查，不是编号规范公式；正式设计必须复核火灾曲线、荷载组合、约束、保护系统、材料模型和整体稳定。
intro.en: This is a derived conceptual screen, not a numbered code equation; formal design must check the fire curve, load combination, restraint, protection, material model and global stability.

label.zh: 火灾设计作用效应（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation；概念表示火灾组合；具体系数必须按采用规范核对。
citation.en: Derived relation; represents a fire combination conceptually; exact factors must follow the adopted code.

label.zh: 温度折减后的抗力（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation；表示温度折减系数的影响；还需考虑刚度、热膨胀、约束和屈曲。
citation.en: Derived relation; shows the temperature factor; stiffness, thermal expansion, restraint and buckling also require checks.

label.zh: 火灾工况作用效应比（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation；ηfi≤1不能替代变形、连接、整体稳定、防火分隔和认证要求。
citation.en: Derived relation; ηfi≤1 does not replace deformation, connection, stability, compartmentation or certification checks.

note.zh: 可对照AISC 360附录4和欧盟Eurocodes资源；中国项目必须按现行防火、结构和消防审查文件核对。
note.en: Compare AISC 360 Appendix 4 and Eurocode resources; Chinese projects must verify current fire, structural and fire-review documents.

classroom.references: AISC 360 Appendix 4; Eurocode structural fire design resources; current Chinese fire and structural codes

text.zh: 火灾设计的关键不是先选耐火时间，而是先定义火灾情景和结构性能，再让热分析、材料模型和构造证据支持目标。
text.en: The key to fire design is defining the fire scenario and structural performance, then making thermal analysis, material models and detailing support the objective.
